## Checklist
- [ ] `gradle :core:test testDebugUnitTest` passes
- [ ] New rules have unit tests (in `:core` where possible)
- [ ] Database change? Version bumped, `MIGRATION_n_m` added and tested
- [ ] User-facing change? Added a plain-language line to `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] UI change? 48dp touch targets, content descriptions, colours from `DT`
- [ ] No secrets, customer data or new network access added without discussion
